title: Core Feature Set & KIMI API Integration
scope: Understand the core KIMI model integration, provider calls, and chat/completion logic.

sdk_or_client.kimi_cli_wiring: src/kimi_cli/llm.py:create_llm() (line 326) instantiates Kimi via match on provider.type == 'kimi'; llm.py line 153 find_kimi_provider() unwraps the provider
sdk_or_client.request_method: self.client.chat.completions.create(model, messages, tools, stream, stream_options, **generation_kwargs) at kimi.py:174-181 (stream) and 184-191 (non-stream via with_raw_response)
sdk_or_client.error_conversion: convert_error() in openai_common.py:75 maps OpenAIError/httpx.HTTPError to kosong ChatProviderError subclasses
sdk_or_client.tool_conversion: _convert_tool() in kimi.py:365 — standard tools -> {type:'function', function:{name,description,parameters}}; $-prefixed builtin tools -> {type:'builtin_function', function:{name}}
sdk_or_client.schema_normalization: _convert_tool applies ensure_property_types() to fill missing nested 'type' on parameter properties (Moonshot rejects type-less schemas)

models.discovery: No hardcoded model list. Models fetched dynamically at runtime via GET {base_url}/models
models.list_models_function: src/kimi_cli/auth/platforms.py:254 async def list_models(platform, api_key) -> list[ModelInfo]
models.capability_derivation: platforms.py ModelInfo.capabilities property (line 26): 'thinking'/'always_thinking' for reasoning or kimi-k2 prefix or thinking-in-name models; 'image_in'/'video_in' from supports flags; kimi-k2 family auto-grants thinking+image_in+video_in
models.allowed_prefixes: ['kimi-k'] for moonshot platforms; models with 'thinking'/'reason' in name are always-thinking

request_shape.messages_structure: OpenAI-compatible ChatCompletionMessageParam array; roles: system|user|assistant|tool. Supports content parts: text, image_url, audio_url, video_url (ms:// URLs from Kimi files API). Assistant messages carry tool_calls; tool messages carry tool_call_id. Moonshot-specific 'reasoning_content' field added by _convert_message (kimi.py:351-352) for think parts.
request_shape.tools_structure: [{type:'function'|'builtin_function', function:{name, description, parameters}}] — builtin_function for $-prefixed tools omits description/parameters
request_shape.generation_kwargs_typed_dict: Kimi.GenerationKwargs (kimi.py:84-101) — max_completion_tokens, max_tokens (deprecated alias normalized), temperature, top_p, n, presence_penalty, frequency_penalty, stop, prompt_cache_key, reasoning_effort, extra_body
request_shape.extra_body: Moonshot-specific extra_body.thinking: {type:'enabled'|'disabled', keep:any} (ThinkingConfig TypedDict kimi.py:55-64); deep-merged via with_extra_body
request_shape.max_tokens_alias: max_tokens is normalized to max_completion_tokens by _normalize_generation_kwargs (kimi.py:317); explicit None opts out

response_shape.chunk_choices: [{index, delta:{role, content, reasoning_content, tool_calls}, finish_reason, usage}]
response_shape.last_chunk_usage: usage dict included when stream_options={include_usage:true} (kimi.py:179); {prompt_tokens, completion_tokens, total_tokens, cached_tokens}
response_shape.cached_tokens_field: Moonshot-specific: usage.cached_tokens (top-level) OR usage.prompt_tokens_details.cached_tokens (OpenAI-compatible) — extracted in KimiStreamedMessage.usage (kimi.py:422-443)

transport.streaming_format: Server-Sent Events (text/event-stream); each event carries line-delimited JSON in the 'data:' field parsed by OpenAI SDK SSEDecoder (_streaming.py). '[DONE]' sentinel terminates stream. OpenAI SDK AsyncStream/SSEDecoder parses raw SSE bytes into JSON objects.
transport.underlying_http: httpx (async) via openai SDK _base_client; stream=True triggers SSEDecoder
transport.sse_decoder: openai._streaming.SSEDecoder / SSEBytesDecoder — splits on newlines, parses 'data:' lines, yields ServerSentEvent with .json()
transport.non_stream: Single POST, full JSON response parsed into ChatCompletion

auth.resolution_order: 1. Explicit api_key arg to Kimi() 2. KIMI_API_KEY env var (kimi.py:113) 3. OAuth-managed platform token (resolve_api_key) 4. Falls back to configured api_key SecretStr
auth.openai_sdk_header: Authorization: Bearer <api_key> set by AsyncOpenAI internally
auth.oauth_flow: OAuth 2.0 device authorization at https://auth.kimi.com (KIMI_CODE_CLIENT_ID='17e5f671-d194-4dfb-9706-5516cb48c098'); tokens persisted to file (KIMI_SHARE_DIR/oauth/kimi-code) or legacy keyring (service='kimi-code'); access tokens auto-refreshed via OAuthManager.ensure_fresh() with 429/5xx retry cooldown
auth.key_validation: API key validated indirectly by calling GET {base_url}/models during setup (setup.py:84-88; 401 => invalid key). OAuth token resolved via resolve_api_key() (oauth.py:848) which loads cached/persisted token, refreshes if expired, falls back to static api_key.
auth.config_storage: pydantic SecretStr in LLMProvider.api_key (config.py:42), serialized via field_serializer to plaintext in config file; managed kimi-code platform stores api_key=SecretStr('') and relies on OAuth ref

proposal: ai-factory could emulate kimi-cli's Kimi provider with a pydantic-v2 pattern: a pydantic-settings BaseSettings subclass (KimiProviderSettings) bound to KIMI_API_KEY/KIMI_BASE_URL/KIMI_MODEL_NAME env vars with a validated default of https://api.moonshot.ai/v1, a SecretStr api_key with a model_validator that raises a descriptive error when no key or OAuth ref is available, and a thin httpx.AsyncClient transport that POSTs to /chat/completions with a pydantic BaseModel KimiChatRequest (using alias_generator/Field(alias) to map provider snake_case keys like max_completion_tokens, extra_body, and the Moonshot-specific extra_body.thinking {type, keep} sub-dict), while a KimiChatResponse pydantic model captures the OpenAI-compatible response shape (choices[].message with reasoning_content/tool_calls, usage with cached_tokens/prompt_tokens_details) and streams SSE data: lines into ChatCompletionChunk-equivalent models via an async generator — keeping request/response as validated pydantic models while reusing a minimal SSE-by-line parser rather than coupling to the full openai SDK.
